subject: Re: Brief Report On Matrons Meeting
body:
Date: 28th / 05/ 2026

Venue: Head teacher’s office

Time: 9:00am – 10:30am

Called by: Head teacher/Head of internal affairs and security

Attenders: As it is attached

1 purpose of the meeting

         To remind matrons on their core responsibilities and rein force compliance with Ministry of Education, guidelines on learner welfare, safety and sanitation in boarding section.

2 key issues Discussed

        I.          1 Dormitory Management: Ensure dorms are locked during class time, beds are laid and learners personal items are kept safely.

      II.          2 Sanitation and Hygiene: Toilets and bathrooms must be cleaned, disinfected and inspected daily before 7:30am.

     III.          3 safety: Daily checks on sockets, extension cords and prohibited appliances in dorms as per MOES guidelines.

    IV.          4 Discipline and care: Matrons to report sick learners promptly to sick bar, handle learners with care and maintain discipline without corporal punishments.

      V.          5 Reporting: Any damage, illness or unusual incidents to be reported to the head teacher or Head of Security immediately.

3 Resolution:

1.      1 All matrons to strictly the duty rotter and cleaning schedule starting 1st June 2026.

2.      2 Daily inspections and signing of toilet cleaning register will be supervised by the Head of Security.

3.      3 Any matron found neglecting will face disciplinary action as per staff code of conduct

4.      4 No releasing dirty students before parents when going back home.

Conclusion

Matrons acknowledge the reminders and pledge to improve performance

Recorded by

MUSIHO YASIN
Head of internal affairs and security
